label: Magicshine Controls
description: Control supported Magicshine lights from the Karoo app or the in-ride field, with lamp selection, quick beam switching, and battery and temperature telemetry.
releaseNotes:
* Stable version 1.0 (version code 31, upgrades Beta 1.4.1)
* Two-second ride-field FLASH with reliable restoration of the previous mode
* Read-only battery and temperature refresh every 30 seconds without changing the light mode
* Detects Bluetooth disconnections and permits reconnecting
* Shares one light state between the app and ride field
* Always cleans up connections after failed OFF writes and stops background jobs on shutdown
